idea-plugin.name: Phantom Workspaces
idea-plugin.description: All open projects in one window, like browser tabs. A tab strip above the editor lists every open project: click to switch, middle-click or the close button to close. Project windows share one size and position (and maximized / full-screen state), so switching looks like changing tabs of one window. Next/previous project: Window | Next Project Window. Works on every OS; no native window tabs. Turn it off in Settings | Advanced Settings | Phantom Workspaces.
